notes: Peer-reviewed INAA study arguing that certain Early Formative carved gray pottery (and related white pottery) found outside the Gulf was exported from the San Lorenzo region — evidence for Gulf → highland movement of vessels. Subsequent critiques and rejoinders exist in the literature; treat as a sourced interaction model, not a closed ‘empire’ narrative. No invented page numbers beyond the article pagination.
